title: Peaks and Valleys A-Z
hook: Every slope has another way back down.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: soft 3D peaks-and-valleys storybook, blue mountains and green valleys, rounded nature shapes, uncluttered

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child tracing terrain shape with eyes and hands from valley to crest and down again
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: re-establish low-rise-crest-return as the route memory
creativeFingerprint.grooveMeter: 6/8 contour sway with rising and descending melodic arcs
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written contour placement; living targets use habitat contrast and tools remain human-use context
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: contour cue -> recall beat -> target -> low/mid/high or shape gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. small echo responses after targets, with acoustic walking pulse
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: small echo responses after targets, with acoustic walking pulse
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make peaks and valleys a true contour song: every phrase rises, falls, crosses, or rests according to landform, while animals and plants occupy honest positions instead of all being 'high mountain' objects.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child reads a side-profile of terrain from valley floor to slope to crest and back down; vertical contour is the recurring compositional logic.
semanticArc: climb through slope animals and rock
descend by waterfall and zigzag trail
forbiddenGenericLanguage: valleys low come sing with me
